verdict.rationale: This product is a laptop processor (CPU/GPU/NPU silicon). Setting up autonomous background automations is a software or agent capability, which is a category error for a chip. The evidence shows no first-party automation feature. Copilot+ voice commands and low-power NPU engines are host-platform or hardware traits, not an automation capability of the processor itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
